lineAr: نُشر من 9 نوفمبر إلى 15 نوفمبر 2026 ما مجموعه 4,555 ثغرة جديدة، منها 322 حرجة و2,212 عالية الخطورة، وأُضيف إلى قائمة الثغرات المستغلة فعلياً 12 ثغرة.
paragraphsAr: شكّلت الثغرات الحرجة والعالية ⁨56%⁩ من سجلات الأسبوع، بينما بقيت 192 ثغرة دون تقييم للخطورة حتى تاريخ النشرة.
وتصدّرت أنواعَ الضعف البرمجة النصية عبر المواقع (XSS) بعدد 331 ثم فيض المخزن المؤقت في الكومة بعدد 329.
وكان ⁨Microsoft⁩ أكثر المورّدين وروداً في السجلات بعدد 1,094 يليه ⁨Google⁩ بعدد 248.
وأدرجت CISA خلال الأسبوع 12 ثغرة في قائمتها للثغرات المستغلة فعلياً، لذا تُقدَّم معالجتها على غيرها.
وأعلى ثغرات الأسبوع احتمالاً للاستغلال بحسب نظام EPSS هي ⁨CVE-2026-75869⁩ باحتمال ⁨20.3%⁩ خلال الثلاثين يوماً المقبلة.

kevAdded.d: Check Point Firewall, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Scalable Platforms, Security Gateway, and Security Management Server contain an incorrect permissions assignment for critical resources vulnerability when the Gaia OS DynamicCLI daemon runs as root and listens on a world-writable local socket without authenticating connecting processes. An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

top.t: Chengdu Feiyuxing Technology VW2100/VEC10GP Weixin Auth Endpoint webserver handle_wechat_cn_wifi os command injection
top.d: A vulnerability was found in Chengdu Feiyuxing Technology VW2100 and VEC10GP 1.0 B-MB3W202-210825-r11775. This impacts the function handle_wechat_cn_wifi of the file var/html/webserver of the component Weixin Auth Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument extend results in os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

top.t: D-Link DIR-600L authentication.cgi authenticationcgi_main stack-based overflow
top.d: A vulnerability was detected in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17/2.17b02. Affected by this vulnerability is the function authenticationcgi_main of the file authentication.cgi. Performing a manipulation of the argument id/password results in stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is now public and may be used.

top.t: Adobe Connect | Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') (CWE-22)
top.d: Adobe Connect is affected by an Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary file system read. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access sensitive files and directories outside the intended access scope. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

top.t: Adobe Connect | Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection') (CWE-93)
top.d: Adobe Connect is affected by an Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection') vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

Adobe Connect is affected by an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access to sensitive resources. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

Adobe Connect is affected by a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

Adobe Connect is affected by a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

top.t: TRENDnet TEW-657BRM mini_httpd setup.cgi sprintf out-of-bounds write
top.d: A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-657BRM 1.00.1. This vulnerability affects the function sprintf of the file /setup.cgi of the component mini_httpd. Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor explains: ""I am not able to confirm if such vulnerability exists as the product has been EOL for more than 15 years. We will send out an announcement letting customers know." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

top.t: D-Link DIR-600L HNAP cgibin hnap_main stack-based overflow
top.d: A flaw has been found in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. Affected by this issue is the function hnap_main of the file htdocs/cgibin of the component HNAP Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

top.t: Linksys EA8100 JNAP API ui_server.lua SetUnsecuredWiFiWarning missing authentication
top.d: A vulnerability was determined in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. This issue affects the function SetRemoteSetting/SetUnsecuredWiFiWarning of the file ui_server.lua of the component JNAP API. This manipulation of the argument isEnabled/enabled causes missing authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

epssTop.d: Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6301 is affected by an authorization bypass and PowerShell command injection vulnerability that allowed authenticated non-administrative users to target unauthorized Windows DHCP subnets and potentially execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows DHCP servers through crafted DNS suffix values.

Zohocorp ManageEngine AssetExplorer versions below 7860, ServiceDesk Plus versions below 15290, ServiceDesk Plus MSP versions below 15150, and SupportCenter Plus versions below 15150 are affected by a authenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the Reports module. An authenticated user with the Create Query Reports permission could exploit specially crafted database queries to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying server.

epssTop.t: Administrator with policy and NAT permissions can bypass Sync network protection on Scalable Platforms
epssTop.d: On Scalable Platforms, an administrator with permissions to edit and install the Access Control Policy and NAT rules can create a NAT rule that redirects traffic to the Gateway's Sync interface, bypassing the built-in Sync protection. This could allow the administrator to execute operating system commands and write files on the Gateway with superuser privileges.

Zoho Corporation ManageEngine DDI Central versions 6500 and below are vulnerable to a Unicode-based command injection vulnerability in the Cisco IOS DHCP configuration functionality. This vulnerability could allow cluster-scoped operators to inject specially crafted Unicode characters, resulting in the execution of unintended device commands.
Zoho Corporation ManageEngine DDI Central version below 6201 is vulnerable to SQL injection in HA replication username handling leading to command execution as the PostgreSQL service account.

epssTop.t: Dixell/Copeland XWEB EVO Pre-Auth OS Command Injection via Username
epssTop.d: XWEB EVO versions 5.2.3 through before 5.7.0 contains a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the username field of login.lua, cleanout.lua, or api.lua before the password check occurs. Attackers can exploit this flaw combined with the setuid-root wlua interpreter to execute commands with root privileges, achieving full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.
Zoho Corporation ManageEngine DDI Central versions 6200 and below are vulnerable to Cisco IOS command injection via DHCP pool name leading to arbitrary commands on managed Cisco routers.

epssTop.t: Dixell/Copeland XWEB EVO Unauthenticated Command Injection via xwconsole.cgi
epssTop.d: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root by exploiting the setuid-root CGI xwconsole.cgi. Attackers can supply malicious input through the sh parameter, which is passed unsanitized to popen(), to achieve full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.
